description: Three-sector decomposition of the discrete entropic functional (Eq. 1)

functional.formula: F[Φ] = Σ_{⟨i,j⟩} κ_ij F(|Φ_i − Φ_j|/a₀) + Σ_i ½ μ_Λ (Φ_i − Φ_V)² + Σ_i λ_i ρ_i Φ_i

sectors.name: gradient
sectors.label: Gradient sector (UV)
sectors.integrand: F(x) = ∫₀ˣ y μ(y) dy (AQUAL kinetic integrand)

sectors.name: bulk
sectors.label: Bulk sector (IR)
sectors.coupling: quadratic coupling to volume-averaged background potential Φ_V
sectors.analogy: Global capacitor providing return path to reference potential (circuit analogy)

sectors.name: source
sectors.label: Source sector
sectors.coupling: linear coupling to local matter density ρ_i

parameters.rho_i: local matter density at node i

sectors.note: Appears as 4πGρ on RHS of Euler-Lagrange equation

euler_lagrange.discrete: Σ_{j~i} κ_ij μ(|Φ_i − Φ_j|/(a₀ a)) (Φ_j − Φ_i) − μ_Λ(Φ_i − Φ_V) = 4πGρ_i

lambda_dual_role.description: Λ is not vacuum energy but bulk entropic capacity

global_role.meaning: Sets the screening length at Hubble scale

lambda_dual_role.structural_feature: Both roles emerge from the single parameter μ_Λ ∝ Λ in the bulk sector

ontological_status.entropy: Functional capacity of the discrete network (not thermodynamic)
ontological_status.energy_flow: Gradient energy redistribution on the graph
ontological_status.cosmological_constant: Bulk entropic capacity — anchoring to Φ_V
ontological_status.spacetime: Emergent from graph structure; no fundamental metric
ontological_status.time: Not fundamental; δF/δΦ_i = 0 is equilibrium; dynamics is relaxation
